children: Solana Mobile said its third-party email marketing provider, Brevo, suffered a security incident that affected some customer accounts, including its own. According to Odaily, Solana Mobile disabled its Brevo account after discovering unauthorized access and is working with Brevo to determine the scope of the information accessed. The company said no emails have been sent from its account so far and added that it does not ask users for seed phrases, private keys, or wallet recovery information.

title: Solana Mobile Says Brevo Security Incident Affected Some Customer Accounts
